title: 8 第八章
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

都竞华再接再厉，很快从土地里挖出了一只箱子。

这大概就是其他人口中的宝箱，虽说从外观上看，都竞华觉得里面的物品应该不会有太大的价值……

她的判断没错。箱子里的是干粮，匕首，两瓶治疗药剂，指南针，以及一个小包袱。

其中价值最高的小包袱是三格背包格，可以合并到玩家的系统背包中。都竞华在交易所中看到过，现阶段一格背包格最低价是十金或者用物品交换，但这并不意味着背包格只值十金，而是初始阶段玩家普遍贫穷，叫不出更高的价格。交易所中有一个版块是仅限觉醒时间未满一个月，等级低于十级的玩家进入的，在论坛上被戏称为救济区，售价十金的背包格只能在这里买到。

剩下那些物品里，治疗药剂是最普通的那种，品质甚至有点差，在背包中会显示为“过期的治疗药”，能恢复50点生命值，使用cd为60秒。指南针则属于场景限定道具，系统没解释其具体作用，只说可以卖到商店中换取一定金钱。干粮虽然经过仔细的保存，可因为时间过去太久，已经完全没有食用价值。至于匕首，倒是一件白板装。

[匕首：攻击力3~7，手柄上似乎沾着一丝陈旧的血渍。]

都竞华将各种道具仔细收好，只将指南针拿在手中看了片刻。

挖掘物品只是一方面，都竞华更多是希望布置一个陷阱。

她还未掌握专业的陷阱技能，所以只能做的粗糙点，先用铲子将土坑扩展到一人多高后，再在上面盖上稻草，然后开始射杀兔子。

【系统：玩家获得经验值1点。】

【系统：玩家获得经验值2点。】

【系统：……】

都竞华在设置中选择关闭普通小怪的经验提示。

捡起兔子，都竞华将一些兔子肉放在陷阱上，然后才开始收拾后面用来交任务的部分，至于多出来的部分，她打算自己留着刷烹饪的熟练度或者挂交易行。

前后捡了五十份兔肉，都竞华感觉心跳微微加速，[事件预知]终于感觉到风中多了一丝属于野兽的腥味，她立刻收好弓箭，往村子的方向跑。《失落大陆》的怪物比较智能，行动轨迹会根据环境的变化而变化，在发现都竞华与自己之间的距离太远后，便将目标转移到了陷阱表面的兔子肉上。

趁着对方追逐食物的间隙，都竞华看清了野兽的外形，那是一只巨狼，狼皮表面似乎萦绕着深紫色的火焰。

怪物看上去充满了魔幻风格，不过都竞华知道，《庆典之前》中的boss只有五级，在行动受限的情况下，单刷起来不算太难。

巨狼boss的智力并不高，被兔子肉引诱落入陷阱当中，它在掉落的过程中依旧试着往上扑，被都竞华一箭射穿了爪子逼退回去。

既然猎物已经成功被困，剩下就是输出。反正副本内没有其他玩家，都竞华用的自然是攻击力最高的[水晶长弓]，在出发前往村外之前，她特地补满了箭囊，结果还是耗到只剩十二支箭矢时，巨狼boss才发出一声愤怒的咆吼，随后重重倒下。

【系统：玩家获得经验值1000点。】

努力是有收获的，都竞华打了半天兔子才升了小半级，单刷一个boss就直接蹿到了三级。在《失落大陆》中，每升一级能获得5点自由属性点，都竞华目前统共有16点属性等待分配。

经过一番调整后，都竞华的面板信息最终定格为以下状态——

【姓名：都竞华

游戏昵称：玩家未曾注册

等级：3

阵营：非法玩家

生命：90/90

法力：140/140

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Du Jinghua kept up his efforts and soon dug out a box from the ground.

This is probably what other people call the treasure chest. Although from the appearance, Du Jinghua feels that the items inside should not be of much value...

She was right.Inside the box are dry food, a dagger, two bottles of healing potion, a compass, and a small baggage.

Among them, the most valuable small baggage is the three-compartment backpack, which can be merged into the player's system backpack.Du Jinghua has seen on the exchange that the current lowest price for a backpack grid is ten gold or can be exchanged for items. This does not mean that the backpack grid is only worth ten gold, but that players are generally poor in the initial stage and cannot bid for a higher price.There is a section in the exchange that is only accessible to players who have been awakened for less than a month and whose level is lower than level ten. It is jokingly called the relief area on the forum. Backpack slots priced at ten gold can only be purchased here.

Among the remaining items, the healing potion is the most common kind, and the quality is even a bit poor. It will be displayed as "expired healing potion" in the backpack. It can restore 50 points of health and has a CD of 60 seconds.The compass is a scene-limited prop. The system does not explain its specific function. It only says that it can be sold to a store in exchange for a certain amount of money.Although the dry food has been carefully preserved, it has completely lost its edible value due to the passage of time.As for the dagger, it's a blank slate outfit.

[Dagger: Attack power 3~7, the handle seems to be stained with a trace of old blood.]

Du Jinghua carefully put away the various props and only held the compass in his hand and looked at it for a moment.

Unearthing items is only one aspect, Du Jinghua hopes to set up a trap more.

She has not yet mastered professional trapping skills, so she can only do something rough. She first uses a shovel to expand the pit to the height of a person, then covers it with straw, and then starts shooting rabbits.

[System: Players gain 1 experience point.】

[System: Players gain 2 experience points.】

[System:...]

Du Jinghua chose to turn off the experience prompts for ordinary mobs in the settings.

After picking up the rabbit, Du Jinghua put some rabbit meat on the trap, and then started to pack up the part that would be used to submit the task later. As for the extra part, she planned to keep it for herself to improve her cooking proficiency or to join the trading house.

After picking up fifty portions of rabbit meat, Du Jinghua felt her heartbeat speed up slightly. [Event Prediction] finally felt the smell of wild animals in the wind. She immediately put away her bow and arrows and ran towards the village.The monsters in "Lost Continent" are relatively intelligent, and their movement trajectories will change according to changes in the environment. After discovering that the distance between Du Jinghua and himself was too far, he shifted his target to the rabbit meat on the surface of the trap.

While the opponent was chasing the food, Du Jinghua saw the appearance of the beast clearly. It was a giant wolf, and deep purple flames seemed to be lingering on the surface of the wolf's skin.

The monsters look full of magical style, but Du Jinghua knows that the boss in "Before the Celebration" is only level five, so it is not too difficult to defeat him alone when his movement is limited.

The giant wolf boss is not very intelligent. It was lured into a trap by rabbit meat. It still tried to pounce up when it fell, but Du Jinghua shot an arrow through its paw and forced him to retreat.

Now that the prey has been successfully trapped, all that remains is output.Anyway, there were no other players in the dungeon, so Du Jinghua naturally used the [Crystal Longbow] with the highest attack power. Before setting off to the outside of the village, she specially filled up her quiver. However, when only twelve arrows were left, the giant wolf boss let out an angry roar and then fell heavily.

[System: Players gain 1,000 experience points.】

Efforts are rewarded. Du Jinghua spent a long time fighting rabbits to reach half a level, and he jumped directly to level three just by beating a boss.In "Lost Continent", you can get 5 free attribute points for each level up. Du Jinghua currently has a total of 16 attribute points waiting to be allocated.

After some adjustments, Du Jinghua’s panel information was finally settled into the following state——

[Name: Du Jinghua

Game Nickname: Player has not registered yet

Level: 3

Faction: Illegal players

Life: 90/90

Mana: 140/140
